name: Sharingtechnology, Inc.
summary: Sharingtechnology, Inc. provides matching services between stores and users in Japan. The company offers Seikatsu 110 ban, a service platform where customers can search, compare, and inquire about household problems services; and Vertical Media, a website that provides customers information on specific subject, as well as operates as a call center. It also offers Mover, a system that enables real-time matching between customers and professional service providers through scheduling and GPS functions. Sharingtechnology, Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. As of October 27, 2026, Sharingtechnology, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Hasegawa holdings Co., Ltd.
